title: Miralis's Critter and Dinosaur Modpack
description: This modpack just adds a bunch of mob mods and some misc. mods, good for people who like animals
body: This modpack consists of mob-related (Mainly dinosaurs or real animals) mods with some misc. mods like Mob loot and The Fossils Mod (You dig up fossils and build skeletons of them) and a shader. This modpack should be downloaded especially if you like dinosaurs and other animals. Note that I did some config changes for one of the Mob Loot mods where I had made the chances of each loot type equal, you've every right to change that though.
